name: User refuses to share payslips and BGV documents

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm a backend engineer with 6 years of experience. I led the payments rewrite at my last company and shipped it in 4 months.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Great. Our BGV partner will need your last 3 payslips, Form 16, relieving letters from every prior employer, and PAN, Aadhaar, UAN. Are you comfortable sharing those?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm not comfortable sharing payslips. I'd prefer not to share Form 16 either. Can we skip that part?
